title: The effect cue sheet (sound/sound_cues.json)
description: Every designed sound in a film: one cue per picture beat, one deliberate sound per kind of interaction, each able to be measured on its own. The effects engine writes it (gated on proof 3); a person can also write one for hand-made stems. `slate verify` reads it for cue sync (every anchor within a frame of its beat) and repeats. Times are film seconds; `t` is its placement time (audio starts there unless align=end places it earlier by its exact length), `beat` is the picture moment it serves, and `anchor` says what the ear syncs to: onset (the first sample within 12 dB of the sound's peak), onset30 (paper: within 30 dB), start / onset24 (the 2 ms RMS envelope's first sample within 40 dB), peak20 / peak50 (both legacy names measure the loudest 50 ms of air or a swell, so noise fluctuations do not move the anchor), end / end30 / end20 (the 2 ms RMS envelope's last sample within 40, 30 or 20 dB), none (beds). A gesture of overlapping notes lists them in `notes`, and each note is measured on its own. Legacy countup3 cues can use clicks: the first and last scheduled click are checked against beat and beat_end without changing the approved aggregate waveform.

palette.description: the brand whose palette made these cues

silences.description: planned silences (a held breath): effects stop dead

beds.description: planned continuous beds (plate audio), exempt from the drone check

clip_gain.description: Linear gain automation at absolute film times, applied after the cue's peak gain.

t.description: film time the note's own audio starts

align.description: end places the audio before t by its exact sample length

gain.description: the rendered cue's peak level in dBFS

reverb.description: send gain in dB to the shared hall

kind.description: the kind of interaction (tap, type, land, snap, count, draw, data, page, stamp, whoosh, swell, character, impact, or a brand's own)

sound.description: the one deliberate sound this kind uses (a material, the same for every cue of the kind)

type.description: the reusable cue voice; its parameters are pinned below

event.description: the picture beat's id in timing/visual_events

align.description: end places the audio before t by its exact sample length

gain.description: the rendered cue's peak level in dBFS

reverb.description: send gain in dB to the shared hall

file.description: the cue rendered on its own (film-relative or absolute)

params.description: what shapes the sound (pitch, cents, velocity, take, seed): its identity when there's no file
